extracted.intended_audience: NIH extramural community (applicants, peer reviewers, program staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance describing temporary modifications to NIH extramural peer review procedures for Advisory Council review cycles (e.g., October 2026), including percent discussed, application designations, and simplified summary statement content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of applications discussed
rubrics_metrics.description: The percent of applications discussed in most meetings will be reduced to 30-35%, instead of the usual ~50%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This modification was applied to address the large volume of peer review meetings missed during the lapse in appropriations and will remain in place for the October 2026 Advisory Council (as it was for January and May 2026).

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of middle and lowest thirds
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications voted by the committee to be in the middle third will be designated as "competitive but not discussed" and applications in the lowest third will be designated as "not competitive and not discussed".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications in the middle third (designated "competitive but not discussed") will nonetheless be considered for funding, along with the discussed applications. Committee vote determines third placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simplified summary statements (no narrative paragraphs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary statements will be simplified. Narrative paragraphs summarizing committee discussion will not be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instead of narrative paragraphs, summaries will include a sentence describing the degree of consensus in the committee vote, plus bullets listing the main score-driving points. This streamlines the content of summary statements compared with prior practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of three assigned reviewers' written critiques
rubrics_metrics.description: Summaries for all applications will contain the written critiques from the 3 assigned reviewers, as is currently the case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no change to the requirement that each summary contain the three assigned reviewers' written critiques; those critiques remain part of the summary package for every application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall impact score only for discussed applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Summaries for applications that are discussed will have the overall impact score.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications that are "competitive but not discussed" or "not competitive and not discussed" will not receive an overall impact score in their summary statements.
